marked_text:
Night sheet from the shed. Sione Tereva, night radio keeper, got the lamp going again over the Avarua quay and wrote while the set hissed. Live slip [[code]]AV-WX-8841[[/]] is the one to file. Drawer copy AV-WX-7720 is last week's sheet and is not this watch. Watch phrases, in the order he heard them: [[phrase]]reef spray[[/]], [[phrase]]gust front[[/]], [[phrase]]low cloud[[/]]. Stamp date on the foot is [[issued]]7 March 2026[[/]]. Salt cracked the word wat
ch on the carbon. Margin note says kia orana. The quay was loud with winches, and he kept the volume down so the phrases stayed readable. Insurer line was never filled. Initials ST.

ask.name: watch_phrases
ask.instruction: Each watch phrase in the order written

marked_text: Talia Hepeti binds the afternoon post at Alofi and this docket came up damp. Binder code on the live card: [[code]]AL-BIN-3096[[/]]. She had already crossed the twin AL-BIN-1184, a morning card that does not belong to this bundle. The phrases on the flap are [[phrase]]torn wrapper[[/]], [[phrase]]wax seal[[/]], and [[phrase]]blue twine[[/]]. Docket date copied through as [[issued]]2026/11/19[[/]]. The typewriter left bun dle split, so she rewrote it. Under the stamp she put fakaalofa lahi atu. The bundle smelled of wet paper, and the twine dye came off on her thumb. No carrier reference was on the string.

ask.name: flap_phrases
ask.instruction: Each phrase written on the flap

marked_text:
Elspeth Quinn, seed-store clerk, pinned this to the bench at Burnt Pine once the mist lifted off the glass. Live bench tag [[code]]BP-NSY-6084[[/]]. The old tag BP-NSY-4418 is still stuck to the shelf and is not the live one. Cover date, copied by hand: [[cover]]14/01/2027[[/]]. The tray was opened [[opened]]9 August 2026[[/]] and closed [[closed]]2026-09-03[[/]]. A blot cut ger
mination in half on the carbon. She left the tray on the upper shelf so the next clerk would see the tag first, then signed EQ. Buyer reference was never entered. STAMP: filed.

marked_text:
From the dues shed in The Valley, in Anguilla. Imani Gumbs, wharf dues clerk, filled the chit while the ferry horn went. Live code [[code]]TV-DUE-7734[[/]]. Last season sits on TV-DUE-2208 with an old total of 61.20, and that figure is not this page. Lines on the chit: [[phrase]]mooring rope[[/]] at [[charge]]18.40[[/]], [[phrase]]lamp oil[[/]] at [[charge]]27.15[[/]], and [[phrase]]wharf chalk[[/]] at [[charge]]9.60[[/]]. Issue date [[issued]]April 2, 2026[[/]]. The horn drowned the first line, so she rewrote the rope entry more darkly. The stamp smeared rec
eived. Rope was salt-stiff. Signed IG.

ask.name: store_lines
ask.instruction: Each stores phrase on the chit

marked_text:
Nadine Querrard runs the reading room in Gustavia and left the roster under the lamp after the shutters stuck. Live roll [[code]]GS-ROL-2468[[/]]. Someone had quoted GS-ROL-1357 from the drawer; that roll is not the one on this desk. Tasks in the order she entered them: [[phrase]]linen count[[/]], [[phrase]]candle stubs[[/]], and [[phrase]]guest cards[[/]]. It opened [[opened]]16 October 2026[[/]] and closed [[closed]]06/11/2026[[/]]. Cover date copied as [[cover]]2027-02-08[[/]]. The aisle lamp buzzed the whole time, and she kept the cards in a single stack. A crease split ros
ter. She wrote bon courage in the margin and signed NQ. Visitor pass line is empty.

marked_text:
Solene Brin, stall fitter, wrote this under the Marigot awning as the rain started on the crates. Job code [[code]]MG-FIT-5193[[/]] is live. Superseded slip MG-FIT-2208 still shows 74.10 and is the old figure, not this job. Fitted, in order: [[phrase]]cable ties[[/]], [[phrase]]fuse caps[[/]], and [[phrase]]bracket screws[[/]]. Hours were [[hours]]5[[/]] at a rate of [[rate]]18.33[[/]]. Issue date [[issued]]27/08/2026[[/]]. She wiped the slip, but ink still broke bra
cket on the carbon. She added merci, signed SB, and left the footing blank.
